nom: Good Molecules Caffeine Energizing Hydrogel Eye Patches

avis.titre: Love these, but with a warning
avis.texte: I've heard great things about these patches and liked that they were clear - so after finishing my last bin, I picked these up. They are cooling upon placing them on my skin and feels like they are depuffing on tired mornings. I do also notice that they cause some light irritation redness on my cheeks where the patches are, so likely won't be repurchasing because of that!

I usually buy the PTR eye patches, but i wanted fo give these a shot. I was reallt surpised how nice they were! It delivered tons of hydration. The only thing i didnt like was they were a little slimy. It didnt feel like normal patches
Honestly this was my first time trying these and theyre so nice!! I like the thiness of them, theh lay on my face well and don't move. I felt a differnecd under my eyes just in one use!

Ive seen a lot of reviews about skin rashes… as someone with VERY sensitive skin + eczema, I was shocked this product feel as good as it does. Right when I put them on I feel thwm working and they brighten my undereyes and depuff so well. My favprite part is that I can wear them to places and people dont really notice I have them on lol.

I tried these because I liked the Good Molecules eye cream. Unfortunately whatever skin care is on these masks is really thick and goopy. It doesn't absorb, so it sits on my skin and pills off when I touch it.

over a month of using these i still didnt see a difference in my under eyes. the product comes in a slimy goo yet feels cooling on the skin but i noticed how irritated my eyes would get afterwards. its a nice price point but i would say invest in a better formula & skip this one!

First off, I'd like to point out that the eye masks are SUPER slimy and difficult to remove from the container so be wary how you do it. Second, if you've managed to remove each one successfully, be sure to use the plastic wand inside to layer them beneath your eyes. I tried using my fingers but it pulled off my skin and stuck to my fingers instead. Third, it actually does feel relaxing and cooling when you leave them on as directed.

I really wanted to like these since good molecules does make good products. However these patches have a serum on them that dry and pill TERRIBLY. They do have a cooling effect and they stick pretty well, so if you like to wash your face AFTER using your eye patches you might like these. They definitely werent for me though.

Been using them for about 3 weeks and I havent seen no difference. Also its very slimmy and sticky. Its just a big No! I put my other moisturizers & just doesn't work with my morning or night routine.

I find these to be incredibly useless. For one, they're a massive pain to remove from the container as you will inevitably grab 2 or 3 at a time because they're so stuck together. Once you get one, it looks and feels like those window clings that kids decorate with. Also, which way does it go? Does it matter? Who knows! As for results, there are none because there is zero noticeable improvement. This brand is just not for me, this is the 2nd product of theirs I've used with no results.

I'm confused why people are complaining about the gel being slimey…It's gel, it's suppose to be that way. What do you suppose is sinking into your skin? The gel! Used for three nights in a row, left on for about an hr. Used on my under eyes, laugh lines and forehead. There is a light sensation on the skin, but I would not relate it to burning. I look refreshed and I do think the areas I've applied to look a bit more vivacious. I'll buy again. Super affordable.

avis.titre: This product is a must have for my daily routine.
avis.texte: I have been using this product for about 2 years now. They feel cool when I place them on my skin, and the area below my eyes after I remove them feels refreshed.

As someone who naturally has a dark circles under eyes, this product really made a huge difference. It works really well as a both morning and night routine. I will definitely purchase this product over and over as it does the job so well but it is also affordable.
These gel pads, definitely perk up and awaken my eyes. They feel brighter and rejuvenated after use. Packaging is a little tough to get one pad at a time.

avis.titre: Super goopy and gave me a reaction
avis.texte: The residue on here stayed for so long!! I could not get it off. It also gave me a reaction and major dermatitis under my eyes, still struggling days later. love all the other GM products

avis.titre: One of the better eye patches on the market personally
avis.texte: I see a lot of people having reactions, but my skin/under eye loves these patches. Brightens and depuffs while moisturizing. Less wasteful as you get a lot of patches, but they are one-time use and the container is plastic that may be hard to recycle

There is way too much serum on these and not matter what it will not completely absorb into my skin. It's been a couple of hours and I've had to wash my face twice to try and get the extra serum that is pilling off

I bought these the other day so excited to use them. The first day noticed the patches turning pink. I took them off and had red under my eye. The next day i tried them the left a burn on my face in the shape of a patch. Don't recommend!!! Especially if you have sensitive skin
Overall these do an okay job, nothing ground breaking. My major issue is the gel/serum that lingers. You have to be thorough about wiping off!

I did not expect this to irritate me as bad as it did. Got some sort of chemical irritetion from it :/ Also the serum on them was super goopy and messy. Dried down to a really gross texture, needed to rinse it.
I really wanted to like this product, but it did not live up to my expectations. I feel like it didn't improve my dark circles at all and it pilla horribly when you wear makeup.
got these eye patches and was genuinely excited to try. they smell legit like cigarettes they smell awful.
Cant use with any other products. Did reduce puffy under eye bad. No problem with irritation.
i liked these they definitely help wake up my eyes. i just wipe off any extra stuff left behind since they leave a film that rubs off after.
I'm not sure they do much for brightening under your eyes and they make my skin sticky after I take them off but they feel nice when they're on
Put these on one night and immediately felt a tingling sensation. Then the following morning i noticed one of my eyes had woken up swollen. Do not recommend! And this was my first time using it

avis.titre: If you want dry, wrinkly, and gunky under eyes…
avis.texte: I was hoping these eye patches would be great for those mornings where your under eyes needed a pick-me-up, but unfortunately this product is HORRIBLE! At first, your under eyes will look/feel great, but once you apply any makeup/concealer, youll start noticing residue thats left from the patches clump up and make a mess around your under eyes. So youll soend time getting those clumps off.. unecessary time added to your make up routine. THEN your under eyes will start feeling dry and look VERY WRINKLY. Itll look loke your havinf an allergic reaction to something (even of your not). I do not recommend these patches. Zero stars for me.

I got these like many others mightve deacribed, excited to use them since it was a bigger pack of eye patches… look, good molecules has plenty of good products, this simply isnt one of them. these BURNED my under eyes and anywhere near where i had rubbed excess product into… don't buy. :(

I wanted to love these for my tired under eyes. I tried them in the morning when i need it most, and the product is just so slimy/wet it never absorbs into the skin. Even if you try to tap it in, when you put makeup on much later it will PILL all over your face. I would maybe only use these on a day I know Im not wearing makeup. But honestly i'll reach for something else thats more absorbable.
I do not have sensitive skin and after having them on for 2 minutes my skin was red and burning. Such a disappointment
Theres pilling on my face after leaving them on for 10 minutes. Also no clear way that you should apply. Rather difficult to separate the pairs especially without the little tool.
My daughter asked for me to pick these up for her and her husband and they love it. I purchased them for myself today.

i was super excited to try these patches but every single time i used them (whether is was 5 or 20 minutes on) it would leave crazy redness. i dont know if i was allergic or if this is common but i had to just throw the pack out.

This product does not "absorb" at all. It sits on your skin then pills and rolls off. Looks like my skin is peeling off around my eyes when I use it. It does help with my tired baggy eyes, but it is NOT worth it due to how it sits on the skin and then is impossible to clear off, instead of being absorbed.
This caffeine hydrogel eye patch works better than anything I have tried so far.
I don't expect my eyes to be returned to what they were 50 years ago, but this is cooling and feels like I am doing something special for myself
Amazing product. Considerably cheaper than most undereye patches and really worked for me.

avis.titre: Learning curve, but I like em!
avis.texte: These took some getting used to, but I do really like them. They're a little awkward to apply (although I've found this to be the case with similar products) and if you don't let the liquid dry/absorb completely before applying other products or makeup, it rolls up like dead skin and flakes off. Once I figured that out, I grew to really like them. They're my go-to on mornings where I feel extra tired or need an extra pick me up. I leave them on for about 30 min before removing, gently tapping in the remaining product, and waiting another 15 min or so before applying anything else. I absolutely would buy them again and glad I sruck with them, but I think the instructions could be tweaked to make them more user friendly.

I used these on 5 clients in one day and 3 of them had bright red outlines of the patches when I took them off and said it was burning/warm. Would recommend gettjng something else if you have sensitive skin.

I picked these up after seeing a video about them on tiktok. I liked the idea that they could be worn more discreetly because they are clear. However, the first time I used them, I had burns/hives under my eyes. I have had this reaction with cheap eye masks in the past so this disappointed me. I really wanted to like these but unfortunately they cause damage to my skin.

Ive tried all the eye patches and these are amazing! They stay in place, and actually work!! My morning eye bags are gone when i take them off. Sort goopey at first but thats just the stuff that works!

Love goes these make my skin feel. They can be a little difficult to dry out of the container and hard to separate from each other. But they are very nice on my skin. I've noticed a reduction in the darkness under my eyes!!! Yay!!!

avis.titre: Was super excited about these but it irritated my skin
avis.texte: Ive used a ton of different eye masks and i was really excited about this pack because it comes with a lot but it irritated under my eyes :(

I added these into my skincare routine because they looked great. However, I put them on as directed, they were on for about 4 minutes before I ripped them off. They had burned my face! A horrible angey burn that was broken out into a burning rash all over my face by the next day and lasted several days. I did not have anything else on my skin when I put these on so there was no chemical reaction with another product. I do not have sensitive skin. My skin was clean and dry as directed. After a deep dive into reviews on TikTok, many others have the same issue with this product.
I wanted to love these eye patches but first time using after removing them I had a bunch piling around my eyes! Don't like at all.

This is my first time using this product. After a couple of weeks it started to irritate my skin. So I stopped using it. Nothing changed in my skin routine. I usually use the yerba mate wake up eye gel from Good Molecules, will probably go back to that

These were so bad. At first, I was really excited because it seemed like they were working. However, once my face dried up and I started applying make up it all just started peeling off of my face and also messed up my make up and made it look like it was peeling as well.
These eye patches pill like no other, leaving gunk under your eyes after you remove them and the moisture dries.

avis.titre: Was okay at first but then…
avis.texte: I really enjoyed these eyepatches for about a week. They felt cool under the eyes and I really think they gave the appearance of looking more awake. I use the same skin products consistently, but one morning they were kind of tingling instead of the cool feeling I was used to. I took the patches off and my skin was very warm and bright red. I washed my face with my cleanser and moisturized, but it stayed that way the rest of the day…

I love this product. I literally will add on to my smile lines as well as the wrinkles between my eyes. It dries so well it looks like it's natural. Totally helps! Plus ita great to use while doing your eyemake up. Because you dont get any make up on those tender undereyes.
I realky loved these eye patches. They are very cooling and feel nice on skin. The only things is they can be pretty slimy which can cause peeling
Used this product a couple of times, used it again and under my eyes were broke out and swollen.

avis.titre: Not for adult skin or before makeup
avis.texte: I bought this to try to incorporate moisturizing, cooling eye masks into my morning routine. I have genetic dark circles, eye bags, and normal to dry skin. These feel wet on the skin, but not cooling , so didnt help "wake me up". Also, these were not hydrating enough for my skin type. Additionally, these pilled immediately, before I put on other products. I gave these to my teenager daughters and they enjoyed them. I think these are only suitable for youth as an introduction to eye masks.

used these in the morning and it was just gloopy and hard to use in general. i took them off and throughout the day i was pilling!! The worst part is the next day i woke up with a stye on the bottom of my eye so i know its from these patches.

The product was indeed slimy and difficult to use. However most notably, the serum pills into rubbery globs. It easily ruins makeup by pilling. Also, it left a rash on both my boyfriend and I's skin. Will be returning.

Well i used these for the first time today with the GM moisturizer. It felt nice but when i opened the package i was greeted with goop. It was chunky. Im not joking. Product was okay but after i took them off i read that it gave people rashes and now im scared. Good luck if you bought it. P.S. i dont have any rash but it does pill.

avis.titre: Can't find anything good to say!
avis.texte: Unfortunately it's a bad experience all the way around. They're so slippery you can't isolate just one, and it won't stay in place. The serum leaves little rubbery globs on your face that pills up when you put on makeup. And they don't work at all!!
I have never been a eye patch girl so these are the first i try and i love using them in the morning especially if i have gotten enough sleep so as i get ready i leave them and do see a difference.
I dont even hsve sensitive skin and they gave me a red swollen rash under my eyes
Such a great eye patch and great serum my under eyes have felt tight for the first time and the caffeine serum has gotten rid of my dark circles

avis.titre: Horrible! Pills, very slimy and goopy
avis.texte: Returned after first use. The product pills badly on the skin, and they're very gloopy when you take them out of the package.

These eye patches really burned on my face. Definitely not for anyone with sensitive skin, i took them off within two minutes. They leave behind product which then dries and flakes weirdly off of your face.

I originally bought to help with the discoloration on my eyes, still working on that but had to use them one morning, for huge under eye bags, from crying myself to sleep, and the improvement is insane! Love love!!
I used these for the recommended amount of time and it made my skin very very red. I dont really have very sensitive skin or anything.
I had burns all under my eyes after one use and tried them again and always got red burns.
I don't think these did anything. It pilled on my skin and just wiped off when it dried. I'm not sure if it penetrated my skin at all either due to the pilling.
Dries on skin and dries out really fast. Leaves residue on skin that you have to peel/rub off. The rest of the Good Molecules brand is amazing, just not the eye patches :(

Got these for Christmas and the moment I put them on, my skin started burning. I took them off right away and the skin under the patches was red and rashy. It looked like a chemical burn in the exact shape of the patches. I rinsed my face, applied aloe, and even took a Benadryl, but it took about an hour before the redness and irritation finally started to calm down. I'm pretty experienced with skincare and have never reacted like this before. I'll be returning.

Got these for Christmas— the moment I put them on, my skin started burning. I took them off right away and the skin under the patches was red and rashy. It looked like a chemical burn in the exact shape of the patches. I rinsed my face, applied aloe, and even took a Benadryl, but it took about an hour before the redness and irritation finally started to calm down. I'm pretty experienced with skincare and have never reacted like this before. I'll be returning.

avis.titre: Great for Mature Skin — A Nighttime Staple
avis.texte: I have mature skin, and these Good Molecules caffeine hydrogel patches have become a true staple in my nighttime routine. After applying my Good Molecules 1% retinol oil, I put these on and they add the perfect boost of hydration and depuffing. They never irritate my skin, and the cooling feel is such a relaxing way to end the day. I wake up looking more refreshed, and my under‑eyes feel smoother and well‑hydrated. I keep coming back to them because they truly make a difference.
These patches gave me a rash and red undereyes. I also do not have sensitive skin.

Wow.. the reviews on this are wild. Fortunately, I have not had of the terrible rash effects others are posting about. However, I will agree they're hard to get out of the container, even with the little tool. They also rip very easily. I wanted to like these, just as something to throw on while watching TV at night, but they honestly offer no change. I don't have dark circles or anything, but I thought they could be helpful in hydrating my under eye area. For the cost, it's incredibly disappointing.

avis.titre: not a fan of the residue but nice and cooling
avis.texte: I like how much serum comes off with the eye patches; they feel cooling and definitely hydrate my skin. However, when attempting to rub in the excess product after 10-15 minutes, a lot of it pilled up and wouldn't absorb into my skin which was frustrating.
Eye patches are way too thin, almost like trying to separate wet tissue paper. And once you get them separated, they tear easily and are difficult to work with
i dont even have sensitive skinnand this made my under eyes completley red. Dont reccomend

I have been using GM products for several months when I tried these. I developed a bad reaction and couldn't pinpoint what had caused it given I had used this product line for so long. Took over a week for it to finally subside. I have never reacted to any skin product in the past and it wasn't until I came to check out the reviews here that I saw others having the same experience. My face was red, itchy, and buring for days around my eyes. It legitimately looked like I had been in a fight. Besides the reaction, as others have said, the texture of the product and the way the eye patches break so easily really makes this product bad all around. Love GM, but miss this product, if you ask me.
Used it on a saturday and was fine, then used it the next day and it gave me a burning rash, turned my skin red.
I absolutely LOVE these eye patches!! They are amazing!! I naturally have puffy under eyes, I get it from my dad. Thought nothing could ever make a difference. Boy was I wrong!!

avis.titre: Leaves a weird film on your face and pills with skincare
avis.texte: I wanted to love these but they left a weird film on my face and when i started doing the rest of my skincare and makeup, it pilled like crazy and got all over my face and hands. Returned immediately, dont recommend

i don't get the negative reviews. sometimes i leave these on for hours and i live in colorado so over time the dry a bit and tighten slightly. imo it gives the surface a smoother appearance and they are super hydrating. these are a holy grail product im never without. the multipack is such a bargain and convenience

I bought these earlier today and was super excited to try them. I left the patches on for about 10 minutes and they were cooling and didn't slide down my face. However, I noticed some redness where the patches were not even an hour after using them. My skin isn't the most sensitive, but i thought these would've been fine.

avis.titre: Fabulous was to start each day
avis.texte: I absolutely love these dnd need to reorder! They make a difference

It was cooling in the beginning, but after leaving them on for 10 min, they made my skin have little red dots and feel really tight after removing. I dont have extremely sensitive skin, but these def gave me some problems. Looking for new eyepatches!

avis.titre: The Most Relaxing Step in my Routine
avis.texte: The Hydrogel Eye Patches are my favorite way to make myself feel fancy or just relax after a long day. Your face will feel cooled and hydrated without being agitated! Ive found that this product works well with other hydrating products so its perfect to work into a slugging/ultra hydrating routine.
Love the tightening aspect of this product. However it had consistently caused mila bumps :( ughhh.

I wanted to love this product, but unfortunately it burned under my eyes. My eyes have always been extra sensitive, as I usually experience eczema flare ups around this area. However, my roomate gave them a try and she really liked them! Said that they felt very moisturizing and helped with puffiness.

avis.titre: Good Molecules Caffeine Energizing Hydrogel Eye Patches
avis.texte: The Good Molecules Caffeine Energizing Hydrogel Eye Patches are a refreshing pick-me-up for tired eyes. Infused with caffeine and soothing botanicals, they help reduce puffiness and give the under-eye area a brighter, more awake look. The hydrogel texture feels cooling on the skin, making them perfect for mornings or after a long day. While results are temporary, they provide instant hydration and a noticeable boost in appearance. Affordable and easy to use, they're a great self-care staple for anyone needing quick under-eye refreshment.

I have been using these eye patches for years now and use them every day / night!! they leave my under eyes feeing so smooth and not sticky at all! I also love how affordable they are! I would definitely recommend this product!

These patches have saved me when I needed them. I'm a 28 year old male, and I don't usually struggle with dark circles because I've maintained my skin through skincare, fitness, and hydration since I was a young teen, but when I'm short on sleep, the puffiness and shadows show up FAST. The caffeine hydrogel formula is extremely hydrating and gives me a noticeable, immediate lift. My under-eyes look smoother, brighter, and less puffy right after removal. What I appreciate the most is how well-engineered the formula feels. It's clean with useful ingredients that actually do something instead of fillers. The instructions are very straightforward, though I do wish they'd specify placement more clearly. In the end though, I switch up the placement of the patches depending on my mood and still get the same results, as long as I cover the affected area. I usually layer it with the Yerba Mate Wake Up Eye Gel and it's AMAZING. All my friends have asked if I've had injections because the area looks so refreshed. This is a repeat purchase for me, and I've already started gifting it to friends. If you want fast, visible de-puffing with real hydration, this should be part of your arsenal.
great! immediately lifts and depuffs my drooping, tired eyes. would like to see this exact product in a cost-effective serum to use on my face in the morning.
worked great for my tired eyes, instant lift and no irritation, worth trying to see if your skin reacts. I will continue to buy this product, and I have tried A LOT of eye products
One of my favorite under eye patches. Stays on and fully hydrates
I really enjoy these eye patches. They are affordable and give me the relief I needed. My eyes are less puffy and the skin feels soft. Would recommend these!!

SOOOOO, I've had these for about a month(actually longer, finally used them). I put them on religiously every morning when I wake up for the last 3 weeks. And, let me tell you the results are outstanding! The difference between under eye skin and facial skin (cheeks) is incredibly noticeable; in a great way. It has made my under eye area SOOOO much smoother, brighter and tighter. I wish they made a face mask; I used one every night...hint hint wink wink!!! Not only did I notice a difference so did the man and the kids on different days (no, they didn't tell one another to say something). But, I am shocked! The results are amazing and consistency is key!!! ps- other products used along side with kiehls avocado eye cream and RoC hydration serum. After I took off the patches I put a full ringfinger tip amount of serum, split between each eye and allowed to that soak in a bit and then applied a thin yet thicker, a nice amount of eye cream under each eye and allowed that soak in on itself. Amazing

These are the worst eye patches I have tried. The serum is snail mucin consistency and leaves a residue that has to be peeled off. The patches themselves are a gel-like consistency (but softer and mushier than most eye patches) and practically fall apart when you remove them from the container.
This is such a refreshing product. I just got it and it has helped I just got back from vacations so haven't slept well lately and this product has help.

I buy these on repeat! They always make me look less tired and they leave the area under the eye looking hydrated and tight. I have very sensitive skin, and they never irritate my skin. I like to put them in the fridge too, the cold always wakes me up :)
Ive used for 2 days ubder eyes and nasolabial folds and i can visibly see a difference. Packing recommends different areas you can apply

I am still in shock how awful these patches are! I tried them out because I love love good modecules hyaluronic acid serum that I use all the time, and to my surprise never had a reaction to the serum with my sensitive skin. Back to the patches, directions said to cleanse then dry and then apply the patches for 5–10 minutes. Patches went on easily and had a cooling effect at first but not even two minutes later I start to feel a tingling sensation and when I looked in the mirror under my eyes are bright red and swollen. I had to ice my face and wait for a while for the reaction to go away. Completely disappointed in this product and shame on me for not reading the reviews beforehand. Lesson learned.

I've been using these eye patches for a couple years now and I love them! They definitely help make my under eyes look hydrated! I personally keep them in the refrigerator to make the experience more relaxing. Not quite sure if you're supposed to do that, but it feels great! The reasoning for 4/5 stars is because after 5 ish minutes it starts to tingle and become uncomfortable. But I don't ever have a bad reaction! The product is still great imo. I just have sensitive skin!
Fabulous!!! From the first use, my eyes look bigger and brighter. My dark circles are fading andnits very noticeable. Will repurchase and highly recommend!
I saw a tremendous difference after a week of using them! These are the best eye patches I've tried so far! I will be ordering again!
I saw a tremendous difference after a week of using them! These are the best eye patches I've tried so far! I will be ordering again!

I enjoy using these patchea but the first couple tries were a very burning sensation, the first two tries being the WORST! I kept trying them to see if thw reaction would change and after about a week of using them they felt fine and no burning sensation. Use at your own risk!

avis.titre: made my under eye all red :(
avis.texte: made my under eye extremely red and swollen. returning this asap ive never had eyepatches do this
First use it was fine. Couldn't wear sunscreen or other serum, it caused peeling. Second use burned my under eyes.
This is the first product I used that actually helped my darkness under my eyes. All the products are amazing. I highly recommend and so affordable 🥰🥰
I bought eye patches multiple times. Love it. They really work. A must use item!
